narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To demonstrate the widespread public support for various proposed reforms to policing practices in the United States.

units.meaning: Require police to be trained has the highest Strongly relative support value.
accepted_routes: Police training leads Strongly support at relative 0.3883.
Highest Strongly value is for police training, 0.3883.
Training reform tops the Strongly series at 0.3883.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The relative value for 'Require police to be trained' must appear as the largest Strongly value.
units.temporal_anchor: requiring training in nonviolent alternatives to deadly force
units.reviewer_question: Must the video state that police training has the highest Strongly support?

units.meaning: Create a federal government has the second-highest Strongly relative support value.
accepted_routes: Federal government proposal is second in Strongly support at 0.3391.
Strongly support for federal government is 0.3391, behind training.
Federal government ranks second in the Strongly series.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The relative value for 'Create a federal government' must be shown as second-largest in Strongly.
units.temporal_anchor: broad base of support for a number of proposals about policing
units.reviewer_question: Should the video specify the second-highest Strongly supported proposal?

units.meaning: Make it a crime for police to Strongly value exceeds investigate and live-in.

basis.entity: Make it a crime for police to

accepted_routes: Crime proposal Strongly value 0.2680 exceeds investigate 0.2352 and live-in 0.1914.
Strongly support is higher for crime proposal than investigate or live-in.
Crime proposal outranks investigate and live-in in Strongly series.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The three named Strongly values must be visibly ordered 0.2680 > 0.2352 > 0.1914.
units.temporal_anchor: broad base of support for a number of proposals about policing
units.reviewer_question: Must the video show the mid-tier Strongly ranking among these proposals?

units.meaning: Somewhat relative support values range from 0.1203 to 0.2133 across the series.
accepted_routes: Somewhat support lowest is 0.1203, highest is 0.2133.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The smallest and largest Somewhat relative values must be visible.
units.temporal_anchor: broad base of support for a number of proposals about policing
units.reviewer_question: Should the video mention the range of Somewhat support values?

units.meaning: Combined Strongly plus Somewhat support is highest for police training at 0.5086.

basis.note: Somewhat part, paired by row order

accepted_routes: Training proposal combined relative support is 0.5086.
Strongly plus Somewhat for training totals 0.5086.
Training reform has the highest combined relative support at 0.5086.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Both training Strongly and Somewhat segments must be visible to support the sum.
units.temporal_anchor: requiring training in nonviolent alternatives to deadly force
units.reviewer_question: Should the video show combined Strongly plus Somewhat support for police training?

optional_valid: Mentioning that both Strongly and Somewhat categories exist for each proposal.
Showing the relative order of all five Strongly support values.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal claims about why public support exists.
Absolute percentages, counts, or dollars from relative-only values.
Extrapolating to public opinion beyond the listed proposals.
Treating numeric entity labels 71, 62, etc. as percentages.
notes: All units use only relative_value. U5 assumes adjacent Strongly and Somewhat rows pair by proposal order.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
